items.comment: Runtime.removeShutdownHook also declares `SecurityException` (thrown if a security manager denies RuntimePermission("shutdownHooks")), which the added doc omits — only IllegalStateException is mentioned.

The exception is documented as a plain prose paragraph rather than an `@throws` tag, inconsistent with the `@param`/`@return` tag usage in `ShutdownHookThread.apply` just below. Prefer `@throws IllegalStateException ...` / `@throws SecurityException ...`.
